outcome: acute aortic dissection (occurrence, type, timing, clinical characteristics, imaging features, associated conditions like aortopathy, hypertension, previous aortic surgery, aortic size)
cohort: The study included 29 women from the International Registry of Acute Aortic Dissection who experienced aortic dissection during pregnancy or less than 12 weeks postpartum between 1998 and 2018.
finding: Most pregnancy-related aortic dissection is due to an aortopathy often not diagnosed until after aortic dissection, with type A dissections associated with dilated aortas and type B often not.
followup_time: Up to 12 weeks postpartum (for event inclusion)
